name: Ice Devil

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Wall of Ice
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the devil can create a permanent, opaque wall of ice up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick, anchored at a point it can see within 60 feet of it. The wall lasts until it is destroyed (AC 5, 15 hit points per 10-foot section, immunity to Cold, Poison, and Psychic damage).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil makes two Claw attacks and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Cold damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Poisoned condition until the end of the devil's next turn.

actions.name: Ice Storm (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The devil casts a barrage of ice in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point it can see within 120 feet. Each creature in that area makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage and 27 (6d8) Cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

description: Ice devils, or gelugons, are hulking insectoid tacticians who patrol the frozen wastes of Stygia, encasing their foes in wall of ice and impaling stragglers on their poisoned tail.
